# Sonaru

> Sonaru is an app for iPhone and Android that tells you when the artists you follow
> release new music - every album, EP and single, in a chronological feed, with a
> notification the moment it lands.

- Platforms: iPhone and Android. Not released yet; sonaru.app is taking waitlist signups.
- Works alongside Spotify and Apple Music. Sonaru does not stream music itself.
- The feed, per-artist notifications and auto-add to a playlist are free and stay free.
  Pro is an optional paid subscription; /pricing carries the current figures.
- Notifications arrive within the first hour of a release landing worldwide, because
  Sonaru mirrors release data continuously rather than waiting for a weekly refresh.
- Release and artist data comes from Sonaru's own mirror of MusicBrainz.
- Made by Marios, in Athens, Greece.

- [How to get notified when an artist you follow releases new music on Spotify](https://sonaru.app/blog/spotify-new-release-notifications):
  what Spotify's What's New, Following feed and Release Radar each do, and where they stop.
- [Pricing](https://sonaru.app/pricing): what is free, what Pro adds, and the FAQ.
- [Press](https://sonaru.app/press): boilerplate at three lengths, logos, screenshots and

- [About](https://sonaru.app/about): why Sonaru exists, who makes it, and how to get in
